d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam cafe style wali Crispy Chilli Cheese Ball banane ki recipe share kar raha hu, ye na, bilkul bhi fatenge nahi, aur super crispy aur molten cheese ke saath pull wali cheese bhi rahegi, double cheese add karenge, aur bhai tried and tested recipe hai to aapko result ekdam sahi me perfect milega..
Ingredients:
Aloo - 2 (grate karne ke baad 1 katori or 2/3 measuring cups)
Green chilli - 5[cs (2 tbsp)
Hara dhania - 2 tbsp
Frozen Hard Pizza Cheese - 1 katori
Oregano - 1 tsp
Chilli flakes - 1 tsp
